title: How to choose the best Update Window in Dynamics 365 Business Central Online
summary: Understanding how to choose the optimal update window for Business Central requires analyzing when platform hotfixes are deployed using telemetry data. The post provides a KQL query to track platform hotfix deployments and recommends scheduling based on when Microsoft statistically deploys fewer updates to minimize disruptions to background jobs.
key_points: Application hotfixes respect the 6-hour update window configured in Tenant Admin Center, while platform hotfixes are deployed independently by Microsoft outside business hours
A KQL query can analyze component version changes in Application Insights to determine when platform hotfixes occur and identify optimal update windows
For Italy/Rome timezone, the 2-8 AM window shows the best distribution for minimizing platform hotfix conflicts with long-running processes
Platform hotfixes deploy least frequently on weekends and on Tuesdays and Fridays, while Wednesday and Thursday see the most deployment activity
